what_it_measured.text: Antioxidant and Antiproliferative Activities of Heated Sterilized Pepsin Hydrolysate Derived from Half-Fin Anchovy (Setipinna taty)

dose.text: The elution consisting of 50 mM sodium phosphate buffer (pH 5.8 containing 0.15 mol/L NaCl) was delivered at a flow rate of 0.4 mL/min. 100 µL of sample (filtered by a 0.22 µm mircofiltre) was injected onto the column.

endpoint.text: The degree of hydrolysis was evaluated as the proportion (%) of total free amino nitrogen in the supernatant with respect to the total nitrogen content in fish muscle.

The reducing power of HAHp-H was measured according to the method of Oyaizu [35] with slight modifications. 1.0 mL of HAHp-H was mixed with 1.0 mL of 0.2 M sodium phosphate buffer (pH 6.6) and 1.0 mL of 1% potassium ferricyanide (K3Fe(CN6)).
The significant differences (P < 0.05) between samples were evaluated through the student’s t-test.

reported_results.text: Results showed that heat sterilization on HAHp improved the 1,1-diphenyl-2-picryl-hydrazil (DPPH) radical-scavenging activity and reducing power.
Thermal sterilization resulted in the increased fractions of HAHp-H with molecular weight of 3000–5000 Da and below 500 Da.

numbers.text: The elution consisting of 50 mM sodium phosphate buffer (pH 5.8 containing 0.15 mol/L NaCl) was delivered at a flow rate of 0.4 mL/min. 100 µL of sample (filtered by a 0.22 µm mircofiltre) was injected onto the column.

The reducing power of HAHp-H was measured according to the method of Oyaizu [35] with slight modifications. 1.0 mL of HAHp-H was mixed with 1.0 mL of 0.2 M sodium phosphate buffer (pH 6.6) and 1.0 mL of 1% potassium ferricyanide (K3Fe(CN6)).
The significant differences (P < 0.05) between samples were evaluated through the student’s t-test.
Results showed that heat sterilization on HAHp improved the 1,1-diphenyl-2-picryl-hydrazil (DPPH) radical-scavenging activity and reducing power.
Thermal sterilization resulted in the increased fractions of HAHp-H with molecular weight of 3000–5000 Da and below 500 Da.
